notes_for_editor: Built year is not in any source read; the 1934 survey mention is the earliest date. Fate: FFLA says gone; no removal date or method found. Brief record matches the sources on status and agency, so no corrections. The hmdb marker is about the CCC camp along Highway 38; the full page text never mentions the lookout, and the story keeps the two apart. Searches: 2 WebSearch-equivalent calls. Reads: 4 distinct pages, plus repeated greps of the cached pages.
